briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources below are dated 2–10 November 2026 unless noted.

**Summary:** Canva has cut about 22% of its workforce (1,271 people) in a restructure it describes as a "re-founding." It is also expanding its OpenAI partnership. Reports disagree on whether further cuts or a hiring freeze are coming.

## What changed

**Restructuring and job cuts**
- Canva announced a restructure affecting 22% of its global workforce. The CEO said "small changes won't be enough" and that the company needs to "re-found Canva" around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- 1,271 employees, over one-fifth of staff, are losing their jobs. The company is flattening its org chart and consolidating teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html).
- Product, growth and platform teams are being merged. Canva also aims to reduce "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Capital Brief reported previously unreported finance-division cuts of 32 roles in January (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Severance**
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary plus other support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The package includes keeping company MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium and career coaching (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- A new fund offers US$10,000 grants to departing staff who want to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).

**Hiring outlook (conflicting reports)**
- Canva reportedly weighs further redundancies or a hiring freeze in November, tied to a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva has not confirmed either (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).

**AI and deals**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI partnership, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Marketing**
- Canva unveiled a North America brand campaign, "What Will You Canva Today?", from new agency GS&P (Goodby's first work for the account). The first TV spot aired during NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

**Hires**
- No hiring announcements were found in the sources.

**Background (outside window)**
- Canva's acquisitions listed in a company profile (Ortto, SimTheory, Doohly at US$30M, Scene Group, MangoAI) are dated February to April 2026 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp). The profile is undated, so treat it as background only.

## Open questions

1. Will the November redundancies or hiring freeze reported by Capital Brief go ahead, and which teams are affected? (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)
2. What savings or cost targets sit behind the expanded OpenAI deal, and how will they affect pricing or the roadmap for Canva Code? (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model)
3. With product, growth and platform teams merging, who now owns decisions and partnerships on our side, and what is the revised revenue growth outlook behind the restructure? (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html)
